xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meeting held on 30th Oct 2026
2. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards Ind AS as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 3 of the Companies Indian Accounting Standards Rules 2015 and relevant amendment rules thereafter.
3. The Auditors of the Company have carried out Limited Review of the above financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 and have expressed an unmodified conclusion.
4. The Company terminated a contract in April 2016 following the investigating agencys findings that the contractor had submitted a bogus qualifying certificate. The matter has been disclosed in the Financial Statements since FY 201516. The project was completed at the contractors risk and cost in terms of contractual provision. The Contractor went into arbitration and filed claim of Rs 40960.75 lakh before the Arbitrator the Company filed a counterclaim of Rs 12907.15 lakh and an application to implead the Contractors parent company. Arbitration proceedings were stayed sine die following the initiation of insolvency proceedings by third party creditor against the Contractor and EIL filed its claims with IRP. Honble Supreme Court stayed the Resolution Proceedings. The Company has approached Arbitral Tribunal and NCLT for revival of its counter claims wherein Company has been directed to approach the appropriate forum and accordingly Company filed an impleadment application before the Honble Supreme Court. The management does not consider any possible obligation on this account requiring future probable outflow of resources of the company. Moreover all the actual amount payable to the contractors are the part of reimbursable cost as per contractual term between EIL and Client.
5. The company has paid final dividend of Rs. 2.50 per share face value of Rs. 5 each for the financial year 2025 26 on 9th Oct 2026 pursuant to approval of shareholders in Annual General Meeting held on 18th Sept 2026.
6. The Board of Directors have declared an interim dividend of Rs 1.50 per share face value of Rs. 5 each for the financial year 2026 27 in their meeting held on 30th October 2026.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
Property, Plant & Equipment and other assets used in the Company's business or segment liabilities contracted have not been identified to any of the reportable segments as these assets and support services are used interchangeably between segments. Accordingly no disclosure relating to total segment assets and liabilities has been made and capital employed has been presented.
In Turnkey Projects of the company, margins do not accrue uniformly during the year. Hence, the financial performance of the segments can be discerned only on the basis of the figures for the full year.
The Company has reported segment information as per lnd AS 108 Operating Segment. The Company has identified two operating segments i.e. Consultancy and Engineering Projects and Tum key Projects.
